# pve_notification_endpoint_webhook (Resource)

Webhook notification endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_notification_endpoint_webhook" "example" {
  method = "post"
  name   = "CHANGE_ME"
  url    = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `method` (String) HTTP method One of: `post`, `put`, `get`.
- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint.
- `url` (String) Server URL

### Optional

- `body` (String) HTTP body, base64 encoded
- `comment` (String) Comment
- `delete` (List of String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target (default: 0)
- `header` (List of String) HTTP headers to set. These have to be formatted as a property string in the format name=<name>,value=<base64 of value>
- `secret` (List of String, Sensitive) Secrets to set. These have to be formatted as a property string in the format name=<name>,value=<base64 of value>

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: name (also the `terraform import` format).
